# Test incremental generation and idempotency
# Verifies that running the generator multiple times produces consistent output

env INPUT_DIR=$HOME/.appledocs/cache/developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation

mkdir incremental_output

# First generation
exec generate-framework-bindings -framework CoreGraphics -input $INPUT_DIR -output incremental_output
exists incremental_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
exists incremental_output/coregraphics/types.gen.go

# Save checksums of generated files
exec sh -c 'shasum incremental_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go > checksums1.txt'
exec sh -c 'shasum incremental_output/coregraphics/types.gen.go >> checksums1.txt'

# Second generation (should produce identical output)
exec generate-framework-bindings -framework CoreGraphics -input $INPUT_DIR -output incremental_output

# Compare checksums
exec sh -c 'shasum incremental_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go > checksums2.txt'
exec sh -c 'shasum incremental_output/coregraphics/types.gen.go >> checksums2.txt'

# Verify files are identical (same checksums)
exec diff checksums1.txt checksums2.txt

# Test that modifying output and regenerating works
exec sh -c 'echo "// Modified" >> incremental_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go'
exec generate-framework-bindings -framework CoreGraphics -input $INPUT_DIR -output incremental_output

# Verify the modification was overwritten (no "Modified" comment)
! grep 'Modified' incremental_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
